- My change: `\d+(\.\d+)?([eEdD][-+]?\d+)?|nan|NAN|[-+]?inf|[-+]?INF`

The difference is `[eE]` vs `[eEdD]`. This shouldn't cause any additional groups.

I need to understand how these extra groups interact with the conversion function and whether they're being populated correctly when the pattern matches.
